g.text: How a claim becomes a purchase
A memory can survive a session. Permission must survive a current check.
Claim + optional source, tenant, and expiry
JSON survives the first worker process
Writer exits. A new process starts.
The original email is not its request.
Current limit and amount already spent
Solid: action flow · Dashed: recalled context / current authority · Moving circles illustrate direction only
All four profiles use scripts. The local serial fixture has no model call, real email service, payment API, or concurrent transaction.
